title: test: the stage-8 test half — suites stop depending on the four catalog row objects (#15204 stage 8, S8-T)
body:
Clause-②: no

Part of #15204 (C3 stage 8, the test half: S8-T). The code half (S8) is built ahead on `claude/issue-15204-s8-catalog-objects` and lands right after this PR. #15204 remains open.

## What this changes

Test files only. Every edit keeps the suite green on `main` **and** on `main` + S8, where the four security-catalog row objects (`sys_position`, `sys_permission_set`, `sys_position_permission_set`, `sys_capability`) are no longer registered (ADR-0131 D3).

- **A testkit for the retired tables.** `plugin-security/src/__tests__/legacy-catalog-objects.testkit.ts` holds the four tables' shapes (fields, indexes, validations only), for suites that model an existing database whose rows outlive the object declarations until the organization-ownership migration (ADR-0131 D10). The suites that registered the object declarations import the shapes from it; `withLegacyCatalogTables()` adds the shapes a plugin no longer declares. plugin-auth's two grant-reader suites register the `sys_permission_set` shape the same way (`plugin-auth/src/__tests__/legacy-catalog-objects.testkit.ts`, a test-only copy: the plugin-security file is no export, and a relative import would make a test read another package's source) before seeding the platform-bucket rows.
- **Deleted, because they pin what S8 removes:** the object-declaration pins (`sys-*.organization-unique`, `sys-capability-deactivation-claim`, `clone-carryover`, the junction/position cases of `rbac-objects`, `reserved-identity-names`, `managed-by-system-data`, `sys-security-assignment-display-title`, `rbac-objects-bulk-exposure`), `position-write-through.test.ts` (S8 unwires that middleware; 7b deletes the module), `bootstrap-platform-admin-refused-existence-read.test.ts` (the legacy-row read S8 removes), `row-active.test.ts` (S8 deletes `isRowActive`), pin 6 of `packaged-permission-set-lock.test.ts`, and the dogfood files for the data-door write-throughs, the projection, the row lock and the junction gates: `two-doors-permission`, `declared-position-provenance`, `permission-set-lock-row-provenance`, `permission-set-write-through-package-binding`, `showcase-permission-projection`, `position-environment-write-through`, `position-held-name-setup-create`. `ensureLegacyPermissionSetRow` leaves the dogfood catalog helper with its last callers. `walled-catalog-data-door.test.ts` (#22895) stays with `main`'s bytes: S8 deletes it together with the walled data-door refusal it pins.
- **Fixtures moved off the rows:** dogfood suites that authored a permission set through `POST /api/v1/data/sys_permission_set` use `PUT /api/v1/meta/permission/:name` (or `protocol.saveMetaItem`); checks that a set "was seeded" read the security catalog (`catalogPermissionSet`) or the registry; vestigial `sys_position` row inserts are gone. `mail-message-pool-read-gate` reads its fixture sets from the catalog (split out and landed on `main` as #23159, `b8f226c440`, the same blob).
- **Pins made to span the change:**
  - censuses of a retired table run only where the object is registered (`showcase-permission-seeding`, the runtime seeder-copy suite, `permission-set-clone-door`, `showcase-d7-default-profile`);
  - `wall-catalog-refusal`'s data-door case answers `403 PERMISSION_DENIED` while the row objects are registered and `404 OBJECT_NOT_FOUND` once they are retired, with no definition either way;
  - `builtin-positions.boot`'s walled golden keeps `control: create a position row` (`403 PERMISSION_DENIED`, the walled data-door refusal of `walled-catalog-data-door.ts`) wherever the plugin declares `sys_position`, and leaves it out only once the object is retired; every other key is unchanged;
  - `cleanup-package-permissions.test.ts` hands the sweep D's `UninstallDeclared` shape (`{ permission: [...] }`) and asserts what holds both ways; D's two named-grant pins are restated over this fixture;
  - the clone-route refusal prose is pinned around the route; the uninstall-cleanup runner request may carry `declared`; page/registry floors drop by the retired page and the four names (the record-page label-map floor is 38, with B2's two maps gone); the tenancy-inventory and dangling-reference fixtures use surviving security tables.
- **New pins:**
  - `bootstrap-platform-admin-fresh-boot.golden.test.ts`: a fresh `single`-posture engine holding only the plugin's own objects promotes its first human (E6's first pin). E6's second pin is the existing `grant-readers-unnamed-grant` suite.
  - `permission-metadata-door-reaches-catalog.dogfood.test.ts`: a create, an edit and a delete through `/api/v1/meta/permission` each reach the security catalog the resolver reads (the premise E1 → A rested on).

## Merge of `main` after D, and the re-check against D

Merge commit `a805619472` takes `main` at `f931e765b7` (D #22900 is `c8a9783eca`). No rebase, no force-push; generated files went through `scripts/pm/os-regen-merge.sh` (this branch touches none; the rerun's step 2 took nothing). Conflicts, all hand-written test files:

- modify/delete, S8-T's deletion taken over `main`'s edit: `bootstrap-platform-admin-refused-existence-read` (D), `position-write-through` (#22895), and the dogfood `permission-set-lock-row-provenance`, `permission-set-write-through-package-binding`, `showcase-permission-projection`, `two-doors-permission` (T2, and #22874's rename);
- `rbac-objects`: S8-T's removal of the retired declaration pins (`main` had only dropped one case inside them);
- `activity-text-predicate`, `approval-snapshot-masked-field`, `sharing-rule-org-less-caller`, `showcase-crud-persona-matrix`: `main`'s `catalogPermissionSet` reads kept, S8-T's `sys_position` insert removals kept;
- `showcase-permission-zoo`: S8-T's side; `showcase-fls-read-mask-strip`: S8-T's metadata-door authoring plus `main`'s catalog read;
- `bootstrap-platform-admin-authenticable-target`, `-promotion-selection`, `per-organization-catalog`: `main`'s `seedLegacyPlatformBucket` import (and T1's removal of `bootstrapDeclaredPermissions`) with the testkit imports;
- `standalone-stack-seeder-declaration-copy`: `main`'s "no row" pin kept beside S8-T's registered-object guard;
- `platform-page-i18n-parity`: the label-map floor restated for B2 and the retired page.

D changed after `fcaedfdaa1`, the base S8-T was first built against. Every case the stage-8 report pinned against D was re-checked on this merge:

| case | result |
|:---|:---|
| S8-T's deletions over D's edits | taken; the deleted suites' assertions are what S8 removes |
| `catalogPermissionSet` reads in the four dogfood files | kept; green on both trees |
| `showcase-fls-read-mask-strip`, `showcase-permission-zoo` | S8-T's side (FLS also keeps `main`'s catalog read); green on both trees |
| `ensureLegacyPermissionSetRow` | deleted from the dogfood helper; no caller left (`git grep`) |
| `showcase-permission-seeding` census | guarded by `getObject('sys_permission_set')`; green on both trees |
| plugin-security imports | `seedLegacyPlatformBucket` plus the testkit; green on both trees |
| D's uninstall cleanup by catalog set name | D landed `UninstallDeclared` (`{ permission }`), not the bare array S8-T was written against: `cleanup-package-permissions.test.ts` now passes that shape, D's two named-grant pins restated; green on both trees |
| E6 fresh-boot golden | green on both trees; ablation below |
| E6 second pin (`grant-readers-unnamed-grant`, plugin-security and plugin-auth) | green on both trees; plugin-auth's copy registers the legacy table before seeding |
| E1 premise (`permission-metadata-door-reaches-catalog`) | green on both trees |
| uninstall-cleanup runner `declared` | green on both trees |

Suites `main` brought in or changed after S8-T's base that read the four objects, made to hold on both trees here: `wall-catalog-refusal`, `mail-message-pool-read-gate`, plugin-auth's two grant-reader suites (legacy table registered before the T2 bucket seed, seat ruling), `builtin-positions.boot` (walled create judged while `sys_position` is declared, seat ruling). `walled-catalog-data-door.test.ts` is kept with `main`'s bytes: green on `main` + S8-T, red on `main` + S8-T + S8 by design, and S8 deletes it with the door.

## Verification

Two trees, built locally through `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`:
- **`main` + S8-T**: this branch.
- **`main` + S8-T + S8**: a local, never-pushed scratch tree, S8's own commit `dbae752f6e` replayed onto this branch, its conflicts with D's final form resolved the way the S8 build-ahead resolved them (D's `captureUninstallDeclared` / `UninstallDeclared` kept; the walled data-door refusal unregistered with the write-throughs).

| suite | `main` + S8-T | `main` + S8-T + S8 |
|:---|:---|:---|
| plugin-security, full | 186 files, 3,831 passed, 45 skipped (at `9d55c0589a`, `walled-catalog-data-door.test.ts` included) | 185 files, 3,815 passed, 45 skipped, 4 failed in `builtin-positions.boot` (at S8-T `008ca32a75`), fixed below |
| `builtin-positions.boot` | 52 passed (at `9d9bdd96b2`; the walled create key judged, `403 PERMISSION_DENIED`) | 52 passed (the key left out) |
| `walled-catalog-data-door` (`main`'s bytes) | 12 passed (at `9d9bdd96b2`) | red by design (`Cannot find module './objects/sys-position.object.js'`); S8 deletes it with the door |
| `cleanup-package-permissions` | 10 passed | 10 passed |
| plugin-auth `grant-readers-by-name.golden`, `grant-readers-unnamed-grant` | 9 passed (at `e40fe491c1`) | 9 failed at `008ca32a75` ("Object 'sys_permission_set' not found"); 9 passed at `e40fe491c1` |
| cli unit (`organization-ownership-inventory`, `platform-page-i18n-parity`) | 35 passed | 1 failed at `008ca32a75` (38 label maps under a floor of 39); 35 passed with the floor at 38 |
| metadata-protocol (3 files) | 89 passed | 89 passed |
| objectql (2 files) | 58 passed | 58 passed |
| platform-objects (1 file) | 20 passed | 15 passed |
| lint, rest, runtime, spec (1 file each) | 15, 11, 13, 11 passed | 15, 11, 13, 11 passed |
| core `src/security` | 37 files, 867 passed | 37 files, 867 passed |
| typecheck | 12 touched packages, 77 turbo tasks green (at `d426f922ed`); plugin-auth again at `e40fe491c1` | plugin-security, plugin-auth, dogfood: 67 tasks green; plugin-auth again at the final head |

Every file changed after a full run was re-run on both trees at the final head. E6 ablation on the `main` + S8-T + S8 tree: with `main`'s (D's) `bootstrap-platform-admin.ts` put back (blob `edf2a164d9`, on disk by hash), the fresh-boot golden goes red, 2 of 2 (`adminPromoted: false`); restored (blob `56166db769`, `git diff HEAD` empty), green, 2 of 2.

## Dogfood

PR and queue CI do not run the dogfood shards (#22998), so this is their first record before `main`'s full battery. The 24 files S8-T touches or that read the four objects, on the showcase boot:

| tree | result |
|:---|:---|
| `main` + S8-T | 23 of 24 files at `9d55c0589a`, the red one `mail-message-pool-read-gate` (`main`'s own red since D; this branch carries the hunk #23159 landed on `main`); at `c0dc292ae8` that file and `wall-catalog-refusal` green, `activity-text-predicate` timed out once (5000 ms, contended box) and passed alone (22 of 22) at `d426f922ed` |
| `main` + S8-T + S8 | 24 of 24 files, 280 tests passed |

No dogfood file changed after `008ca32a75`.

## Gates

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derives 89 commands for this diff at `9d9bdd96b2` (the same 89 as the dispatch's list at `0d43004100`). All 89 ran after the final commit and exit 0 (`check:dual-build-cjs-loads` first answered PREREQUISITE NOT MET, exit 3, and exit 0 once every package was built); `--ran` with each exit code recorded: "89 derived, 89 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN". `check:entry-nameability` keeps its existing note that `@objectstack/spec/api-assembled` and `/qa` have no callable export to measure; `packages/spec` is untouched.

## Size

93 files, +1,255 / −3,950 = 5,205 changed lines against the merge base `f931e765b7`, almost all deletion: over the 3,000-line line, so this lands by the maintainer's approval. `mail-message-pool-read-gate` leaves the diff at the next `main` merge (`main` carries the same blob).

`skip-changeset`: only test files, a test-only testkit under `src/__tests__` (no entry imports it; `files` ships `dist` only) and the private dogfood package change.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

**改了什么**
C3 第 8 阶段的"测试半边"(S8-T),只改测试文件:93 个文件,+1,255 / −3,950 行,绝大部分是删除。四个已退役的安全目录行对象(`sys_position`、`sys_permission_set`、`sys_position_permission_set`、`sys_capability`)将在 S8 中取消注册;本 PR 先让测试不再依赖它们:删除只钉住"S8 要拆掉的行为"的测试,夹具改为走元数据门(`/api/v1/meta`)或读安全目录,少数断言改成无论对象是否注册都成立。本轮还把 D 落地后的 `main` 合进来,并修了 `main` 新带进来、依赖这四个对象的 5 个测试文件。

**为什么改**
ADR-0131 D3 规定权限集、岗位、能力只有一个归宿:安全目录(注册表)。S8 取消注册这四个行对象;测试若不先迁走,S8 一落地就会大面积变红。测试半边单独先落,S8 本身的代码改动才能保持可审。

**风险与代价(含回滚)**
- 只动测试,产品行为零变化;回滚即 revert 本 PR 的合并提交。
- S8 落地前的短窗口里,`main` 上少了几条钉"即将被拆掉的行为"的单元测试(如数据门写穿);走廊下数据门的创建拒绝(`walled-catalog-data-door.ts`)仍由原样保留的 `walled-catalog-data-door.test.ts` 和 `builtin-positions.boot` 钉着,S8 连同该门一起删除它们。S8 紧随其后落地。
- 超过 3000 行,按规则需要您的批准;其中约 76% 是删除。
- PR 与队列 CI 不跑 dogfood(#22998);两棵树都已在本地跑过,`main` 的完整测试组是它们在 CI 上的首次记录。

**席位意见**


**你要做的**
批准本 PR(授权批准或亲自合并);之后席位接着落 S8。
